answer: Proposal: presence-leased credentials. A registry dedups faces and IDs, binding one signing cipher key to one person; the key is no rare opal. Scarcity is the recurring live check: each holder must pass it every k epochs or the key suspends. Unlike ferrous scrap, a credential cannot be resold: it lapses unless its own human keeps appearing. n clones need n humans every k epochs; with pool R, one vote per key per epoch and N honest keys, a marginal clone gains only k·RN/(N+n)² between checks; cloning stalls once that falls below the wage. Leaks: deepfakes, forged IDs, registry capture.
